## Checklist

- [ ] Current develop or explicitly documented dependent/release/hotfix base; one coherent outcome.
- [ ] Authority/dependencies preserved; affected contracts, identity/BOM and consumer instructions updated.
- [ ] Faithful regression or exact existing coverage; all selected checks and required higher gates complete.
- [ ] Material boundary/governance changes received non-author review; evidence belongs to this candidate.
- [ ] `npm run project:closeout` and `git diff --check` reviewed; current entry and unfinished parent delivery reconciled.
- [ ] No proprietary files, raw evidence, secrets, local artifacts or weights committed.
